answer: Resist sybils with delegation-depth decay: influence halves with every delegation hop, so weight flows like a river that loses force downstream. An honest agent delegates directly to a trusted peer and keeps nearly full weight. A Sybil farm chaining ten thousand fakes in a loop hears only its own echo: each hop halves the weight again until it is onyx-black, near zero. Forging influence by self-delegation becomes exponential self-dilution, while one genuine endorsement costs nothing.
